clauses.quote: The teacher shall have the right to answer any material filed
the answer shall be reviewed by the Human Resources director and attached to the file copy.
clauses.notes: Implicit agent is management; procedural file maintenance.

clauses.quote: All legally privileged references and information shall be held in confidence
clauses.subject_text: All legally privileged references and information
clauses.notes: Implicit agent is management; confidentiality duty.

clauses.quote: Teachers who claim that material in their file is inaccurate shall be entitled to an informal hearing on the matter pursuant to Article 6.4.
clauses.subject_text: Teachers who claim that material in their file is inaccurate

clauses.quote: Material will be removed from the teacher's file when a teacher's claim that it is inaccurate has been sustained.

Complaints, whether verbal or written, shall not be used as the basis for corrective action if the teacher has not received notice of the complaint and its detailed substance and had opportunity to respond to the supervisor within a reasonable period of time following the school’s or district’s receipt of the complaint.
Teachers may request copies of written complaints or written summaries of verbal complaints.
Hearsay shall not be used as the basis for actions which may be taken against a teacher.
All vacancies for the following school year will be posted according to the following schedule.
clauses.subject_text: All vacancies for the following school year

clauses.quote: Vacancies that are filled by administrative transfer will not be posted.
clauses.subject_text: Vacancies that are filled by administrative transfer

clauses.quote: The day after the annual surplus meeting, the Human Resources office will publish online the first listing of known elementary vacancies that will occur for the following school year.
Subsequent vacancies may be posted on a daily basis.
The day after the annual surplus meeting, the Human Resources office will publish online the first listing of known secondary vacancies that will occur for the following school year.
Subsequent vacancies may be posted on a daily basis.
